notes.title: A Milestone Achieved
notes.notes:
Greetings Dark Chess players!

Today we’re releasing what is going to be our final major update for Dark Chess. A game that started as a dream and became our first Steam release. We spent a few years developing it, learning a lot along the way, and thanks to your feedback we made it even better after the release.

Before we get into what’s new, we just want to say thank you. Your feedback, your passion and your support brought Dark Chess to life and kept it going all this time. This game will always be special to us and we hope it holds a special place for you too.

What’s New in This Update?
⚔️ Goodbye to Online Multiplayer
After two and a half years, we’re shutting down the online servers. In the last six months multiplayer activity dropped significantly, so it was time to let it go.
The chess battles can continue, just a little closer to home. You can still play against friends using the Pass and Play mode on the same device. 

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements
We’ve rolled out one last round of bug fixes based on the issues you reported. Thank you to everyone who sent us feedback and reports.

🌐 Ukrainian Language Support
A big thank you to Serhii for his help in improving the Ukrainian localization! 💙💛
If you want to help us bring Dark Chess to your language, we’re open to community translations. Let us know – every bit of help counts!

➡️ New “NEXT” Button
We know some levels in Dark Chess can be really tough or not as engaging for every player. To keep the experience enjoyable for everyone, we’ve added a NEXT button.  If you’re stuck or just want to skip a level, now you can.

🌱 What’s Next?
We’ve been supporting Dark Chess for over two years, but now it’s time to focus on our next game – Untraveled Lands: Chantico.
While we won’t be actively working on Dark Chess anymore, we’re still here to fix critical bugs and issues if they come up. Don't hesitate to share your findings with us.

Thank you for every game, every piece of feedback, and for being part of this journey. This chapter is ending, but a new adventure is about to begin.
See you in Untraveled Lands: Chantico!

Dark Chess Team

notes.title: Winter Wonderland Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow travelers.

We've been actively listening to your feedback over the past few months, and we're excited to announce a significant game update! This update focuses on enhancing your gaming experience by addressing bug fixes, fine-tuning game balance, and resolving various issues that you've highlighted. Our commitment is to provide a smoother, more enjoyable gaming experience, and we're grateful for your continued support and valuable suggestions that help us improve.

🌠 Brace yourselves for a delightful ride through our latest improvements:

🗣️ Voiceover Extravaganza: We've waved the magic wand! Say goodbye to repetitive chatter! Voiceovers now make their grand appearance just once. No more déjà vu!🌟

🎨 UI Transformation: Our UI has gotten a slight makeover! Expect more vibrance, more style, and an extra splash of creativity. Our visual party never stops! 🖌️

🧠 AI Revolution: Our AI has leveled up! Expect a brainier, trickier opponent on each difficulty level. Ready for the challenge? 💡

🎯 Piece Placement Precision: Say hello to pinpoint accuracy in piece placement! We've fine-tuned those hitboxes to ensure every click counts. 📍

🌐 Language Adventure: On a quest to squash typos in every language! Found one? Give us a shout, and we'll jump into action. 📢

🐲 Cixi's Fair Play: We've adjusted Cixi's castling powers. No more sneaky moves when she's down to her last King. It's all about fairness now! ⚖️

🛡️ Lagertha's Loyal Army: Lagertha’s troops were a bit too good at hide-and-seek, staying invisible. We’ve fixed this bug, and now they return as expected! 🎩

🗡️ Leonidas' Warm-up: Remember when Leonidas was freezing during loading? We've relocated him closer to the Realm of Hades for some much-needed warmth. No more chilly battles for him! 🔥

📜 Juana's Clarity: Got puzzled by Juana's powers? We've cleared the air. She might be mad, but we try to make her easier to understand on a winter sunny day. 🌈

🎮 Demo Redesign: Our long-neglected demo has finally been updated to reflect the current state of the game. Dive in and see what's new! 🆕

♟️ Dark Chess Strategy: The turn repetition rule in the fog is back! Say farewell to endless move loops and hello to strategic gameplay. 🌫️

🌠 Your insights are our guiding light, helping us make the game more epic. Thank you for your trust and dedication! Let’s keep the fun rolling! 🚀🎲🎮

notes.title: King's Gambit Bundle
notes.notes:
[b]We are happy to unveil our latest offering - the King's Gambit Bundle! [/b]

This bundle features four exciting chess-like games that are guaranteed to keep you on the edge of your seat.
All games use chess as a foundation for snappy, turn-based, tactical and strategical gameplay, and yet they do it in very different and exciting ways.
From tactical depth to infinite replayability, this bundle offers hours of gameplay that will challenge your mind and sharpen your strategic thinking skills.

Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate brings a whole new level of intensity to chess, as you replace your entire army with a royal shotgun! This one-of-a-kind strategy roguelike takes the timeless checkboard classic to new heights, with infinite replayability and an array of exciting challenges to conquer.

Dark Chess - a unique twist on chess that introduces fog of war mechanics, challenging single-player campaign with puzzles, various chess variations and dirty tricks that you must overcome to emerge victorious.

The Ouroboros King combines the best of both worlds, blending the tactical depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Build a formidable army, discover powerful relics and take on the Covenant, encounter endless surprises that will keep you hooked for hours on end.

Pawnbarian is a quick-playing, turn-based puzzle roguelike that will put your chess skills to the test. Play cards to move your hero like a chess piece, and conquer challenging dungeons full of cunning monsters!

Whether you're a seasoned player or simply love a good strategy game, the King's Gabmit Bundle has something for everyone. 
Get ready to immerse yourself in hours of challenging, mind-bending gameplay that will keep you coming back for more! Don't miss out on this epic bundle - grab it now and start your strategic adventure today!

notes.title: One week after release of Dark Chess
notes.notes:
[b]THIS IS NOT A GAME OF CLASSIC CHESS.[/b]
That should be our motto. 
The most significant criticism we receive is that our game is not a chess game, as indicated by negative reviews and game returns. It is disheartening to discover that people are not reading the description, not examining screenshots, nor attempting to comprehend why we chose to name the game Dark Chess. 

[b]Disclaimer[/b]
We are considering adding a prominent disclaimer at the beginning of the game, ensuring that players understand that it is not a classic chess game. After they confirm they will be bounded to sell their souls if they ever say anything about it not being a classic chess game. 
We want to make it clear that the game is based on alternative rules and variations of chess, and we hope that players will appreciate and enjoy it for what it is. 

[b]The Campaign[/b]
While we didn't originally plan for it, we have decided to create a single player Campaign for both Classic Chess and Dark Chess. Although some people may still find something to complain about (especially in regards to Classic Chess), we believe that it will be of interest to many of our players.

[b]Feedback[/b]
We've received a lot of feedback from players since the game's release, and we're working hard to make improvements based on what you've told us. Here are a few things that were heavily requested:

[olist]
[*] The ability to change set pieces for the Campaign. We've heard you and are working on implementing this feature.
[*] Achievements. We understand that Steam achievements are important for many players, and even though the game already has its own achievements, we are working hard to implement Steam achievements as well.
[*] Windowed mode. We've received requests to enable windowed mode, and while it's already possible to access it using the alt+enter combination on your keyboard, we understand the convenience of having it available in the game settings. Therefore, we are currently working on adding the option to play in windowed mode in the game settings.
[*] Some players found the game too hard, so we've added an Easy and Normal Campaign modes to make it more accessible to chess newbies. 
[*] Puzzles are too hard. Puzzles were also a challenge for some players, so we've added a hint button for every Puzzle. The button first shows you the piece you need to move, followed by a 15-second cooldown before it shows you where to move it. You can repeat this process as many times as you need to.
[*] Bugs. We appreciate your help in finding bugs, and we're working to fix them as quickly as possible. If you encounter any issues, please let us know in discord or via email at play@talltroll.com.
[*] Some players have said that the game is too short, but it should take between 5 and 10 hours to complete the Campaign. You can also play Solo and PvP modes if you want to spend more time in the game.
[/olist]

If you don't like playing against a particular opponent in the Campaign, please let us know what you liked or disliked about the game. Your feedback will help us adjust and balance the game for the best possible experience.

[b]You can help.[/b]
If you enjoyed playing the game, we would be grateful if you could [b]leave a review on Steam[/b]. Your feedback helps other players and also helps Steam gain a better understanding of our game. Additionally, you can share the game with your friends and family. We have also added Steam's Remote Play Together, which allows you to play the game with your Steam friends, even if they do not own the game yet. 
[b]Your support means a lot to us.[/b]
[b]Thank you![/b]

notes.title: Dark Chess is released!
notes.notes:
[b][i]Hear ye, hear ye, lords and ladies of the realm! Let it be known that a new game has arrived, and it's unlike any other game we've ever played before. It's called Dark Chess, and it's a twist on the classic game we all know and love.[/i][/b]

The game introduces a Fog of War feature, which shrouds the enemy army in mystery, making every move a strategic and tactical challenge. But that's not all! Dark Chess also offers a fully narrated, story-driven campaign mode, where players can meet and challenge famous kings and queens from the past, such as Genghis Khan, King Solomon, and Queen Elizabeth.

But it's not just the gameplay that sets Dark Chess apart. The game features an all-new visual chess experience, with customizable avatars and profiles that allow you to create your own unique chess identity. And for those who prefer to test their skills against other players, Dark Chess offers a thrilling PvP mode, with opponents who are as clever and tricky as you are.

[b][i]So, my lords and ladies, if you seek a new challenge to test your wits and strategic mind, look no further than Dark Chess. Whether you're a die-hard chess lover or a board game enthusiast, Dark Chess is the game for you![/i]
[i]
For those brave souls who dare to take on the game, we encourage you to write a report of your triumphs and tribulations. Share your experience with others and spread the word![/i][/b]

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
[b]The Road Goes Ever On...  [/b]
[i]J. R. R. Tolkien[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35786786/7789612284d9b4e8b528f3b0bb8a246947b59140.png[/img]

It's been quiet on our side after [b]Early Access[/b] was released and first fixes were made so we decided to share the Roadmap for the next few months. Our team is proud to say that we are on the finishing road before the final release. It is still a hard way and a lot of things we need to tune and enhance before we can happily say that we’ve done our best and are satisfied with the result. [b]But we never stop.[/b]

Today we make a promise that the game will be released as soon as this Roadmap will have all the green check marks in it. This is not the exact order we are going to add features to the game. More of a general list of what can be expected to be added. Stay with us and check from time to time to see how close we are getting to the release.

[i]You are always welcome to Follow, Wishlist (if not yet), leave a feedback, share ideas or buy the Dark Chess in Early Access. [/i]

[i]Stay Strong![/i]

Thank you
[b]Tall Trolls[/b]

notes.title: Long Live the Queen Patch
notes.notes:
[h2]First patch "Long live the Queen" is ready.[/h2]

[h3]We heard your feedback so dialogue flow was fixed. [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Irrelevant comments by the opponent will be shown in a different way. You don't need to skip the dialogue when opponent has anything to say anymore.
[*] Minor tweaks and bug fixes to play the game more smoothly.
[*] Added a few more languages to the game: 
[list]
[*] French
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Russian
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[/list]
If you want to offer your help in improving current localization or translating the game into your native language you can do so in Discord server.
[*] A few players reported that they've missed level progression on the map after playing two missions. We have added more POI on the campaign map so you won't miss anything. 
[/olist]

[i]Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/VMdDpE44DA]Discord server[/url] to discuss game, leave a feedback or report a bug[/i]
